title: BRP Reference Table File
description: Schema for Basic Roleplaying reference-table JSON files. Each file groups one or more related lookup tables (skills, professions, or equipment stats) from the SRD, rather than random-generator tables.

usage_note.description: File-level note on how the table's chances or fields are used.

roll.description: The mechanic used with this table, e.g. 'D100 (roll ≤ chance to succeed)', or 'Reference (no roll)'

usage_note.description: Optional note on how or when to use this table

entries.description: An array of objects, one per skill/profession/weapon/armor/shield entry. Field names vary by table (see individual files) since these are reference tables rather than flat roll results.
